text:
Iris (PM): quick sync on model catalog compare UI — two asks: make pinning clearer and reduce vertical clutter for large compares.
Mina (Design): current per-row pin is easy to miss. sketch: add a header-level pin toggle that enters a pinning mode, plus keep small per-row pins for context.
Theo (Eng): header pin mode is fine. we'll need to persist mode in session storage; persisting server-side would be extra work.
Rae (Research): in tests people tried header first. per-row pin used mainly to confirm selection. header-primary sounds good.
Ava (A11y): header pin must use aria-pressed and announce mode changes via polite aria-live. per-row pins need descriptive labels like "Pin model v1.2 for compare".
Mina (Design): density: propose a compact toggle in the toolbar that reduces padding and abbreviates badge labels. show legend icon that opens a small helper panel.
Theo (Eng): compact CSS class is simple; badge abbreviations OK if full text is present in aria-label. watch for long model names — ellipsize.
Iris (PM): decision: header pin primary, per-row secondary; add compact toggle (defaults off); include legend + a11y labels. Can we prototype this week?
Theo (Eng): will branch and demo Thurs. adding metrics: pin_mode_toggled, compact_toggled, legend_opened.
ci-bot: preview app ready at https://staging.redwood.company/review/4721
Mina (Design): will upload two mock variants to the Figma file and include token values + contrast guidance.
Ava (A11y): I'll run a quick axe pass on the preview and post fixes.
Iris (PM): thanks — please keep copy short for badges, full text in tooltips. Ping if blockers. :thumbsup:
